title: Stieltjes Regimes of Polya-Schur Multipliers and Strict de Bruijn-Newman Bounds for the Davenport-Heilbronn Function

certified_theorems.name: Three-Regime Stieltjes Classification of Polya-Schur Multipliers & Lacunary Root-Gap Obstruction
certified_theorems.verification: Stieltjes log-derivative Borel-Laplace classification on (0, 2*sigma* - 1), disjoint-interval Rolle-Hurwitz subproduct extraction under w_{j+1} - w_j = o(sqrt(w_j)), and tower-lacunary counterexample R_1 = 16, R_k = 2^(2^(R_{k-1}))

certified_theorems.name: Strict Separation Between Asymptotic Kronecker Type and Global Real-Rootedness for Polya's Hyperbolic Sinc Multiplier
certified_theorems.verification: 320-bit Arb IVT enclosure of sigma* = 1.120362498183... combined with 384-bit Arb Taylor + 512-arc Cauchy + Interval-Newton certificate at h = 311/500 and a 64-ball parametric continuum cover across h in [310/500, 311/500]

certified_theorems.name: Shifted Gauss-Weierstrass Asymptotic Simplicity & Strict Upper Bound Lambda_DH < 2*(sigma* - 1/2)^2
certified_theorems.verification: Half-line Gauss-Weierstrass folding, exact boundary IBP identity, explicit Abel bound < 4*sqrt(tau), and de Bruijn equilateral-hyperbola contraction on |Re z| <= 2*gamma_0(t_1)

certified_theorems.name: Strict Unconditional Separation Lambda_zeta <= 1/5 < 1153/5000 < Lambda_DH via Interval-Newton Witnesses
certified_theorems.verification: 640-bit and 704-bit Arb Interval-Newton certificates near rho_240 at t = 1/5 and t = 1153/5000 = 0.2306, plus 1350-bit Arb Interval-Newton certificate near rho_531 at t = 1/5
